claims.statement: The selected Fire roster consists of the exact live DJ, EK, and FL sequence sources in diamond mode.

checks.name: shell-continuity
checks.evidence: Measured from the loaded GLB in the browser, not from the build script: one FF_Shell_Rock of 6068 vertices spanning -30.8 to 30.8 by -1.4 to 11.5 by -23.8 to 23.8 metres, and zero free-standing FF_Basalt_ prisms. Each court carries the section it was carved with - DJ crown 7.6m with 410 wall vertices in the 6 to 9m band, EK crown 6.0m with 641, FL crown 9.2m with 447 - so the three courts are three different rooms by geometry rather than by dressing. carve-shell-section-measurements.json holds the raw numbers.

rejection.quote: the floor is all fucked up doesn't connect to the walls The walls are kind of randomly spaced I just don't really feel a sense of great cohesion here maybe it's because it's meant to be a tunnel system it's going to have textures replacing the walls If so we should just build it that way

supersedes.quote: I think we're really on the right track and I'm pretty happy with the Gray box now. What's the next major phase?

rejection.finding: The shell is a navigation blockout, not a room section. scripts/build-first-fire-graybox.py lays one flat 58 by 44 metre slab (FF_Shell_Floor), four perimeter boxes at the bounding box, and no ceiling object of any kind - the script contains no roof, no solidify and no boolean. Every interior wall is a free-standing prism from contract.basalt set down on that slab, so no floor meets any wall. Nine of those prisms are named fill-* and exist only to occupy the floor the route does not use, which is what reads as randomly spaced. The route, widths, sightlines and occlusion that Gate 1 measured are unaffected and stand.
rejection.remedy: Rebuild the shell by carving rather than stacking: sweep the walked section along each contract centreline, dome the courts where corridors meet, union those volumes and subtract them from a solid mass. Floor, wall and ceiling then share one continuous surface by construction, the fill-* masses cease to exist because leftover floor becomes impossible, and the plan contract is consumed unchanged.
rejection.note: Rejection returns the scene to Gate 2 without discarding its evidence: the artifacts below remain the record of what was walked and approved on 2026-08-09, and are superseded only when the carved shell replaces them.
rejection.remediation: The shell is carved. scripts/build-first-fire-graybox.py now sweeps a mitred tunnel section along every contract path centreline, revolves a per-court chamber where corridors meet, joins those 25 volumes into one negative and subtracts it from a single rock mass with an exact boolean. FF_Shell_Floor, FF_Shell_North, FF_Shell_South and all 27 free-standing FF_Basalt_ prisms - including the nine fill-* masses - no longer exist as geometry. The GLB carries one FF_Shell_Rock object of 1585 faces, and the verifier fails the build if a basalt prism ever returns.
